# A valid every cut 4 bytes into its 100-byte out-of-line fixed-length opaque at offset 32.

type every
breaks 5.2, point 10.2; 5.4, point 2
expect Truncated -
offset 32
extent 4
requests none
input 00000001 00000002 00000000 00000003 00000000 00000004 00000001 00000004 0a0b0c0d
